title: Transformative Winter Experiences in the Canadian Rockies
includes: Customizable Itinerary for a Bespoke Experience
All Safety Equipment for the adventure is provided
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience winter through a private transformative journey in the breathtaking winter landscapes of Banff and Kananaskis. This private guided experience offers immersive winter adventures, intentional reflection, and meaningful connections, each designed to provide an intentionally connected and iconic experience.

Choose from immersive winter ice walks through Johnston Canyon or snowshoeing through picturesque landscapes of Lake Louise. Embark on an ice climbing excursion or journey into the backcountry on a ski touring adventure. Immerse into a winter wellness journey or feel the excitement of exploring the outdoors at night through a winter night hike. 

Customize your journey where every moment is curated to your values and outcomes. Embrace the Rockies, go beyond the viewpoints and get more from your experience in Banff. The real Canadian winter experience awaits!
